opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 429 U. S. 814.] Motion of Acting Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument on behalf of petitioner granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondent also granted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
